risks.title: Intellectual property litigation
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions several active disputes (EcoFactor, Causam, SkyBell) regarding intellectual property, with requests for injunctions and significant damages. The intensity of the language (adverse effect on our business) and the repetition of similar disputes justify a high severity level.

risks.title: Data security risks
risks.score_rationale: Although the text does not detail specific risks, it explicitly mentions risks related to data security and the associated risks to our business at the beginning of Item 1A. The importance of the IoT platform and the data processed suggests a high severity.

risks.title: Dependence on service provider partners
risks.score_rationale: The business model heavily relies on a network of independent partners for the distribution and installation of solutions. A failure or loss of these partners could significantly impact revenues.

risks.title: Technological complexity and evolution
risks.score_rationale: The platform must remain competitive in a rapidly evolving technological environment. R&D expenses are increasing regularly (5.6% in 2025) to maintain competitiveness.
